ticket.subject: Line item order resets after saving
ticket.body: When I drag line items to change their order on an invoice and then save, the order goes back to how it was before. I tried twice on two different invoices. It is not a big emergency but it is annoying because I like to put the labour lines first. Using Windows 11 and a current browser.

note: Bug not covered in the KB, so no grounded answer and the agent must escalate.
